docs.title: Tidal energy overview
docs.snippet: How tidal turbines generate electricity and how much tidal turbine capacity is installed.
docs.body:
Tidal energy overview.

Tidal turbines generate electricity from the movement of ocean tides. The Northbay project has an installed tidal turbine capacity of 6 MW. Tidal energy output is predictable years in advance because tides follow the moon.

Contact the editors for corrections.

docs.title: Tidal energy cost explained
docs.snippet: What tidal turbine energy costs per megawatt hour and where the cost is heading.
docs.body:
Tidal energy cost explained.

The levelised cost of tidal turbine energy was about 260 pounds per megawatt hour in 2023. Analysts expect the tidal energy cost to fall as installed turbine capacity grows.

Subscribe to our newsletter.

versions.body:
Tidal energy cost explained.

The levelised cost of tidal turbine energy fell to about 190 pounds per megawatt hour in 2025. Analysts expect the tidal energy cost to fall as installed turbine capacity grows.

docs.title: New tidal turbine array announced
docs.snippet: A larger tidal energy array will add installed turbine capacity.
docs.body:
New tidal turbine array announced.

A developer announced a tidal energy array with 30 MW of installed turbine capacity off the coast of Wales. Construction of the tidal turbine array is planned to start in 2027.
